♦️ **FLEX GUI PRO V9.3.0 YAVAPO! (AFTER EFFECTS)**

**MAP RIGS 2.0**, AutoCaptions ine **Your script** uye **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe**, pamwe ne **Flex Studio (Beta)** inotanga yadhawunirodha yobva yakubvunza isati yaiswa.

*(Isa pamusoro peshanduro yako yazvino wobva watangazve After Effects kamwe chete.)*

♦️ **Zvitsva: MAP RIGS 2.0**
* Marongerwo anonzi **Map desk**, kutsvaga nzvimbo pasina indaneti, **Quick looks** (Country Pop, Space Dive, Trip Route nezvimwe), Stick to Map, Clean labels, Always Sharp, masitaera emamepu emahara uye **Open in Flex Maps**.
* Maturusi ayo ekuwedzera (live sync, masitaera, malabel, 3D, Finalize) zvino anonyatsovhurika mukati me After Effects.

♦️ **Zvitsva mu AutoCaptions**
* **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** (cloud, inoshandisa makiredhiti e Flex AI) ndiyo injini inokurudzirwa, yakasarudzwa kamwe chete kune wese. Sarudza Whisper zvakare kuti uite ma caption mahara pakombiyuta yako (Translate To inoda Whisper). Kana server yakabatikana, inokuratidza nzvimbo yako pamutsara.
* **Your script**: ma caption anotora zviperengo nemashoko e script yako pese pawakataura mashoko iwayo.
* Kubuda kwe **Editable template**: ma caption semalayer e template aunogona kugadzirisa masitaera mu Essential Properties (After Effects 2026).
* Hapana chakasarudzwa uye Source media isina chinhu? Inopa **composition yose**. Odhiyo imwe chete inoshandisazve transcript yayo.

♦️ **Flex Studio (Beta)**
* **Download Flex Studio (Beta)** inodhawunirodha, yobva yabvunza **Install / Not now**.
* App (2.0.0-beta.2): nzvimbo dzekushandira **PRO, TRACK, ROTOSCOPE, COLOR GRADING**, makiyi ematurusi akafanana ne After Effects, ma clip anovhurika ipapo ipapo, uye OPEN inoshanda pa precomp nema adjustment layer.

♦️ **Zvagadziriswa**
* Ma theme effect aive asipo pamakombiyuta mazhinji e Windows adzoka (akareruka kana ma animation effect e Windows akadzimwa).

♦️ **Nzvimbo yausingamanikidzwi kupa, yekudzivirira rezinesi**
* Unobvunzwa kamwe chete, hazvimanikidzwe: kunyangwe ukasarudza **No thanks**, zvese zvinoramba zvichishanda. Chichinja mu **Flex Settings > Privacy**. Inochengetwa kwemwedzi 12, haitombotengeswi, uye haitombogovaniswi kunze kwekunge mutemo wazvida.

♦️ **FLEX ULTIMATE V2.3.0 YAVAPO! (PREMIERE PRO)**

**Caption Stack yapinda mu AutoCaptions** ine masitaera eshoko rimwe nerimwe, marongerwo, kufamba uye manzwi. **UN-NEST** nema blend mode zvinoshanda pa Premiere 26.5, **AUTO CUT** kudzvanya kamwe chete, uye **Flex Studio (Beta)** inovhura clip yako ichibva pa panel.

*(Isa pamusoro peshanduro yako yazvino wobva watangazve Premiere Pro kamwe chete.)*

♦️ **Zvitsva: Ma caption anofamba mu AutoCaptions**
* **Sitaera yeshoko**: ipa shoko ripi neripi mavara aro, font uye kupera kwe Flat, Shine kana Glow.
* **Marongerwo emitsara**: Stack, Over, Under, Beside uye Line.
* **Kufamba kweshoko rimwe nerimwe** (Fade, Pop, Rise, Type, Shake nezvimwe) ine preview, pamwe nemanzwi e **Pop / Tick / Swoosh**. Masitaera emashoko nekufamba zvinoda kubuda kwe **Images**.
* **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** (cloud, inoshandisa makiredhiti e Flex AI) ndiyo zvino injini inokurudzirwa, yakasarudzwa kamwe chete kune wese; sarudza injini ye Whisper kuti uite ma caption mahara usina indaneti.
* **Your script** (Captions mode): ma caption anotora mashoko e script yako paunenge wataura mashoko iwayo.
* Pasina chakasarudzwa (Source card isina chinhu) inopa **timeline yose**; ma caption anochengetwa padivi pe project yako.

♦️ **Zvitsva: Flex Studio (Beta)**
* **Open in Flex Studio** inoteedzera clip mu app; **APPLY TO PREMIERE** inodzosera track. Haina kuiswa? **Download Flex Studio (Beta)** inoidhawunirodha, yobva yabvunza **Install / Not now**.

♦️ **Zvachinjwa**
* **AUTO CUT** inoongorora clip yakasarudzwa yobva yacheka nekudzvanya kamwe chete. **Retakes** inobata mitsara yakatangwazve.
* **Audio Studio** ine ma sub-tab matanhatu. **Library** zvino inogara mu Nest Saver.

♦️ **Zvagadziriswa**
* **UN-NEST** pa Premiere 26.5 (yairamba nest yega yega), nema blend mode akaita se Screen aidzokera ku Normal (Premiere iri muChirungu).
* Chip tsvuku ye **AUTOSAVE 0:00**, preview nhema ye Caption Stack, uye ma theme effect aive asipo pamakombiyuta mazhinji e Windows.

♦️ **Nzvimbo yausingamanikidzwi kupa, yekudzivirira rezinesi**
* Unobvunzwa kamwe chete, hazvimanikidzwe: kunyangwe ukasarudza **No thanks**, zvese zvinoramba zvichishanda. Chichinja mu **Flex Settings > Privacy**. Inochengetwa kwemwedzi 12, haitombotengeswi, uye haitombogovaniswi kunze kwekunge mutemo wazvida.
